Mong Sui Thowai Chowdhury (born 9 December 1953) is a Bangladesh Nationalist Party politician and a former Khagrachari Pouroshova member representing the Khagrachhari District. He is the Member of the Pouroshova on 9 No Word. He was served as Minister of Chittagong Hill Tracts Affairs .
Early life
Chowdhury was born 9 December 1953 in Khagrachari District. He has a under BA. He is from Marma community which is known Marma in Bangladesh.
Career
Chowdhury was elected to three terms Commissioner from Khagrachhari District as a Khagrachari Pouroshova.
Before that he served as "chairman" of Marma Oikay Porishod Khagrachhari Hill District Council.
Chowdhury was appointed as Bangladesh Nationalist Party  Chittagong Hill Tracts Affairs on 11 January 1999.
